task_summary: PTPN2 expression & IFN-response analysis in NTC CD4+ Tregs vs Teffs (GSE278572)

steps.title: Build NTC 10x matrix
steps.description: Stream the remote matrix, keep only the 21,943 single-guide non-targeting-control (NTC) cells, and write a compact 10x trio (barcodes/features/matrix) plus the HTO condition table. (Running in background.)

steps.title: Load, normalize, log1p
steps.description: sc.read_10x_mtx the NTC trio; basic QC (min genes/cells); sc.pp.normalize_total(target_sum=1e4) then sc.pp.log1p. Keep raw counts in a layer.

steps.title: Define CD4+ Treg / Teff
steps.description: Restrict to CD4+ T cells (CD3E>0, CD4>0, CD8A==0). Treg = FOXP3>0 & IL2RA>0; Teff = FOXP3==0 & IL2RA==0. Cross-tabulate against HTO condition label as a sanity check; report counts per group and per lane.

steps.title: PTPN2 Treg vs Teff
steps.description: Wilcoxon rank-sum on PTPN2 log-normalized expression (Treg vs Teff); report p, log2 fold-change, rank-biserial effect size, and bootstrap 95% CI of the difference.

steps.title: Type I IFN score & correlation
steps.description: sc.tl.score_genes for [IFIT1, IFIT3, MX1, OAS1, ISG15, IFI44L]. Within Tregs, Spearman-correlate per-cell PTPN2 vs IFN score; repeat in Teff as negative control. Report rho, p, 95% CI.

steps.title: STAT5/JAK co-expression matrix
steps.description: Within Tregs, pairwise Spearman among PTPN2, STAT5A, STAT5B, JAK1, JAK3, FOXP3; build correlation matrix for the heatmap.

steps.title: Lane-level pseudobulk paired test
steps.description: Pseudo-bulk mean PTPN2 per lane per cell type (Treg/Teff); paired Wilcoxon signed-rank across the 8 lanes; report p and per-lane values. Labeled lane-level (donor not recoverable).

steps.title: Compute UMAP
steps.description: HVG → scale → PCA → neighbors → UMAP on the CD4+ subset; store cell-type labels for coloring.

steps.title: Composite figure
steps.description: Assemble 4-panel figure with figure-style: (A) UMAP by cell type, (B) PTPN2 violin Treg vs Teff, (C) IFN score vs PTPN2 scatter in Tregs, (D) STAT5 co-expression heatmap. Annotate effect sizes and FDR-corrected p-values.

steps.title: Stats table & FDR
steps.description: Assemble all test results into one table with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the family of tests, effect sizes, and 95% CIs; save figure, table, and annotated AnnData checkpoint as artifacts.

desired_outputs: Multi-panel composite figure (UMAP by cell type, PTPN2 violin Treg vs Teff, IFN-score vs PTPN2 scatter, STAT5 co-expression heatmap)
Statistics table: Wilcoxon PTPN2 Treg vs Teff (p, FDR, log2FC, effect size, 95% CI); Spearman PTPN2~IFN in Treg & Teff; pairwise Spearman matrix; lane-level paired signed-rank
Compact NTC 10x matrix + annotated AnnData checkpoint

feasibility.rationale: All required genes and the NTC cells are present and the pipeline is standard scanpy. Two caveats: (1) the full 3.86 GB matrix exceeds available RAM, so I stream-filter to the 21,943 NTC cells before loading (faithful to sc.read_10x_mtx on the subset); (2) true donor identity is not recoverable from the deposited files (HTOs encode condition, not donor; no genotypes), so step 7's pseudo-bulk uses the 8 lanes as the replicate unit — clearly labeled as lane-level, not genetically-resolved donor-level.
